phase: 9B.1 — real accounts, cloud career, My EraClash

results.name: one versioned migration exists and records its own version
every user-owned table exists with a user_id bound to auth.users
a profile is unique per user and its name is length- and content-constrained
one clash per user per result, and one owner per result
the result id shape is enforced in the database, not only in the client
career statistics are derived views, not mutable counters that can drift
no email column, no seed, no key, no password anywhere in the schema
the device session is stored only as a 64-hex hash
a snapshot is stored so a saved report survives the result cache expiring
exactly one profile is created per sign-up, idempotently
deleting an account cascades rather than orphaning private career data
